【介绍】：NudgeForMe scans your sent conversations, finds threads where someone never replied, and drafts natural follow-ups inside your own mailbox. It starts in draft mode, so you stay in control. Built by the Snoooz team after processing millions of emails, NudgeForMe is focused on one painful workflow: making sure leads, deals, partnerships, and customer conversations do not quietly go cold.
